The '''receiving chamber''' was one of the assembly areas used by the Sorcerers of Rhand. It was located in the [[Central ruin of Rhand|Central Ruin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhand]] in the [[Nihil Retreat]] [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] of the [[Perann Nebula/Legends|Perann Nebula]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The structure the chamber was located in had been built millennia ago by the [[Unidentified Rhand species|original inhabitants]] of Rhand who had disappeared and left only ruins behind. In [[80 BBY/Legends|80 BBY]] a [[Historian/Legends|chronicler]] from [[Carrivar]] named [[Succate]] ventured to the Central Ruins of Rhand to learn more about the Sorcerers. In the ruin's receiving chamber, Succate was harassed and intimidated by Rhandites in various states of disassembly and decay.
